description: TopologySpreadConstraint describes how a group of pods ought to spread across topology domains.

labelSelector.description: LabelSelector is used to find matching pods.

maxSkew.description: MaxSkew describes the degree to which pods may be unevenly distributed.

topologyKey.description: TopologyKey is the key of node labels.

whenUnsatisfiable.description: WhenUnsatisfiable indicates how to deal with a pod if it doesn't satisfy the spread constraint.
